versions.changelog:
Academic Pipeline Suite v1.0.0

- Initial release of the academic-suite meta-skill package.
- One-click offline installation for the entire Academic Pipeline ecosystem.
- Bundles 8 key dependencies, including academic-pipeline v3.5, academic-search, deep-research, academic-paper, paper review tools, humanizer (EN/zh), ima-skills, and integrity-verification agent.
- Unified 12-stage academic research and writing workflow with mandatory checkpoints.
- Added HUMANIZE (Stage 10), enhanced startup configuration, and improved integrity/peer review flow.
